environment.description: Same IoT gateway service deployed via containerd with a custom OCI runtime spec. The container runtime configuration references a node-local seccomp profile at /etc/containerd/seccomp/iot-gateway-restricted.json which was generated by the security team's profile auditor. The profile operates in SCMP_ACT_ERRNO mode for the following syscall groups: execve (nr 59), execveat (nr 322), clone3 with CLONE_NEWUSER, and fork/vfork. The profile permits read/write/openat/close/mmap/brk/futex and standard Python interpreter syscalls but the exec-family denial means subprocess.run() and os.system() will receive EPERM. Note: the profile does NOT filter socket/connect/sendto syscalls since the gRPC framework requires them for normal operation. The profile is applied at container creation time via RuntimeDefault override in the pod annotation (runtime/default is NOT used; the custom profile path is specified explicitly).

config.note: socket/connect/bind/listen are ALLOWED for gRPC operation
config.profile_application: OCI runtime spec, applied at container start
